description: Entra ID sign-in logs exported to a Log Analytics workspace (SigninLogs, AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs).

queries.name: Sign-ins for a user
queries.description: Interactive sign-ins for one UPN, newest first.
kql: | project TimeGenerated, AppDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription, IPAddress, Location,

queries.name: Failed sign-ins for a user (grouped by reason)
queries.description: Why a user is failing to sign in: error codes with counts, IPs and apps.
kql: | summarize Attempts = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),

queries.name: Locations and IPs for a user
queries.description: Where a user signs in from. Useful for impossible-travel and compromised-account checks.
kql: | summarize SignIns = count(), Successes = countif(ResultType == '0'), Failures = countif(ResultType != '0'),

queries.name: Conditional Access results for a user
queries.description: One row per CA policy evaluated per sign-in (excluding policies that did not apply).
kql: | project TimeGenerated, AppDisplayName, PolicyName, PolicyResult, ConditionalAccessStatus, ResultType, IPAddress

queries.name: MFA prompts and failures for a user
queries.description: 50074/50076 MFA required, 500121 MFA failed, 50072 prompted to enroll, 50158 external challenge.
kql: | project TimeGenerated, AppDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription, IPAddress, Location, AuthenticationRequirement

queries.name: Non-interactive sign-ins for a user
queries.description: Token refreshes and background app sign-ins (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs).
kql: | project TimeGenerated, AppDisplayName, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription, IPAddress, Location, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent

queries.name: Sign-ins from an IP address
queries.description: Which accounts and apps an IP touched, and whether they succeeded.
kql: | summarize SignIns = count(), Successes = countif(ResultType == '0'), Failures = countif(ResultType != '0'),
Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 10), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)

queries.name: Sign-ins to an application
queries.description: Who signed in to a given app (partial name match).
kql: | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription, IPAddress, Location, ConditionalAccessStatus

queries.name: Password spray indicators
queries.description: IPs with bad-password or lockout results across many different accounts.

queries.name: Top failing users
queries.description: Accounts with the most failed sign-ins.
kql: | summarize Failures = count(), DistinctIPs = dcount(IPAddress), LastFailure = max(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName

queries.name: Legacy authentication sign-ins
queries.description: Anything that is not a modern-auth browser or client (IMAP, POP, SMTP, ActiveSync, EWS ...).
kql: | where isnotempty(ClientAppUsed) and ClientAppUsed !in ('Browser', 'Mobile Apps and Desktop clients')
| summarize SignIns = count(), Users = dcount(UserPrincipalName), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by ClientAppUsed, AppDisplayName

queries.name: Successful single-factor sign-ins
queries.description: Users getting in with no MFA. Review against your CA policies.
kql: | summarize SignIns = count(), Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 10), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName

queries.name: Risky sign-ins
queries.description: Sign-ins flagged low/medium/high by Entra ID Protection (needs P2 licensing).
kql: | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ('low', 'medium', 'high') or RiskLevelAggregated in ('low', 'medium', 'high')
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, RiskLevelAggregated, RiskState, RiskEventTypes_V2, IPAddress, Location, ResultType
